questions.question: Marker for bone formation:
questions.explanation: Osteocalcin is a marker of bone formation; TRAP indicates resorption.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Osteomalacia is caused by the deficiency of:
questions.explanation: Osteomalacia is caused by vitamin D deficiency.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Kreb cycle takes place in:
questions.explanation: The Krebs (citric acid) cycle takes place in the mitochondrial matrix.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: The principle of diet planning for an individual comprises that out of the total calories requirement the carbohydrates should provide:
questions.explanation: Carbohydrates should provide about 50-60 percent of total energy.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: The characteristic of collagen is presence of:
questions.explanation: Collagen is characterised by glycine at every third residue (Gly-X-Y), along with proline and hydroxyproline.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Joint Structure and Function/Norkin/3rd Ed./Pg. 56

questions.question: The factors responsible for viscosity of synovial fluid is/are:
questions.explanation: Hyaluronic acid gives synovial fluid its viscosity.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
